findings.summary: The closure manifest models future JSON create or replace effects but has no non-mutating binding for an already-applied exact candidate awaiting a distinct owner decision.
The aggregate public suite returned 1 with two closure-fixture failures, although the negative matrix, real cross-capability regression, and a focused canonical two-run replay passed.
No acceptance, selection, chain approval, Task Session state, product mutation, Git operation, publication, or external effect was performed.

recommended_contract_change: Add a fail-closed final-candidate identity mode that binds a live aggregate inventory and explicitly declares no material effect, while keeping the owner decision and any acceptance record separate. Preserve create and replace semantics for unapplied material candidates.
